messages.content: Predict a real participant's recorded response in an anonymous German laboratory experiment. Roles were randomly assigned and fixed: Player A is the dictator allocating money, and the paired Player B is the recipient with no veto or return choice. Each situation offers Option 1 and Option 2, specifying euro payoffs to A and B; totals may differ and this is not an unconstrained transfer. The experiment has three sections. Participants receive a guaranteed 4-euro show-up fee. At the end one of the three sections is randomly selected for payment, in addition to the fee. Choices in other sections do not themselves add payments. Detailed instructions are supplied only when each section starts. Decisions and assessments of other participants are not disclosed during the experiment. Payment is made privately at the end. Own earlier responses below are already known. Predict the human report without advice or moral judgment. Your first-section allocation guesses are your own reports, not observations of the dictator's actual choices. In section 1, if this section is selected, one of the ten situations is randomly drawn and the dictator's chosen option determines both paired players' earnings. Your guess earns no accuracy bonus and cannot change the allocation. Detailed instructions for later sections are not yet given. Output only 1 or 2: the option B predicts their paired A will choose, not B's own allocation.

Your role: Player B (recipient). Laboratory: Heidelberg. Current section: 1; situation 1/10. Option 1 pays A 7 euros and B 4 euros; Option 2 pays A 5 euros and B 5 euros.
No earlier response is supplied.
Own stable background: age 21 years; gender female; classified as an economics student.
